faqs.q: Why is LEAD Summit capped at exactly 300 seats?
faqs.a: Most conferences pack thousands of people into massive auditoriums where high-impact conversations are impossible. AMCOB deliberately caps LEAD Summit at 300 verified founders, executives, and decision-makers to guarantee intimacy, authentic confidentiality, and high-value deal making.

The summit is engineered around five tangible pillars: reconnecting you to your commercial and ethical purpose, sharpening your operational strategy, putting real capital and customers in front of you, providing a personal behavioral and cognitive assessment, and surrounding you with an enduring peer advisory board.

faqs.q: What does the Behavioral & Cognitive Assessment include?
faqs.a: Every full summit attendee receives an advanced executive evaluation measuring cognitive problem-solving, behavioral decision-making under stress, and leadership archetype mapping, with actionable coaching on how to leverage your innate strengths.

faqs.q: Where will the event take place in Anaheim?
faqs.a: LEAD Summit Anaheim takes place at a premier executive hotel and convention property in Anaheim, California. Registered delegates receive direct room block booking links ($550 discounted 3-night rate) upon ticket confirmation.

faqs.q: Are meals included with summit registration?
faqs.a: Yes. Full Summit passes include Friday evening dinner reception, Saturday breakfast, lunch, and the evening Banquet Gala, as well as Sunday breakfast, lunch, and all day coffee and refreshment breaks. All food provided is strictly Halal certified.
Yes. While AMCOB members receive priority registration and preferred seating, the summit welcomes all qualified business founders, executives, and aspiring leaders across North America.
